ground_truth_breadth_enhancement:

(2) the Godfrey-Smith "independent experiment in the evolution of large and complex nervous systems" quote/framing -- while it reuses a quote also available in the exploitation-phase material -- is paired here with an explicit "consciousness can arise from different evolutionary paths" framing that connects to convergent-evolution as an adjacent conceptual domain; however, since the underlying quote itself is also present in exploitation-phase research (not exclusively exploration), the stronger and cleaner instance for this section is item (1).
